title: Are you Human?
description: Whenever you do stuff you get asked a question (e.g. Are you human)
body:
This mod adds a question gui asking "Are you Human?"(or "Are you a Robot") on 

!Be Carefull clicking ESC without clicking Done/No(You will crash)!
It has a chance to open a gui on most interactions 
When the gui opens it will say "Are you Human?" or "Are you a Robot?"
